279875853.description:
Mineral and Rock Specimen Set with Labeled Plastic Cases 20+ Samples
This listing includes two plastic cases labeled 'Minerals,' each containing multiple raw, unpolished mineral and rock specimens. Each compartment is labeled with the mineral name, featuring samples such as Hematite, Mica, Amazonite, Copper Ore, Gold, Jasper, Selenite, Variscite, Talc, Alabaster, Turquoise, Pyrite, Chalcopyrite, Amethyst, Smoky Quartz, Rose Quartz, Fluorite, Galena, and more. The minerals vary in color, shape, and size, and are organized in clear plastic cases for easy viewing. The set is in good used condition and suitable for collectors, educators, or hobbyists interested in geology and earth sciences.

Description:
Add timeless charm and practical organization to your collection or study with this vintage wooden pipe rack and humidor set by Decatur Industries. The set includes a beautifully crafted woodgrain rack with space for up to six pipes, alongside a classic barrel-shaped humidor designed to keep your tobacco fresh. The rich brown wooden construction provides both durability and a handsome display, complemented by a soft felted base with an original Decatur Industries sticker for added vintage appeal. This set also comes with five assorted pipes, featuring a variety of materials such as wood and a distinctive corn cob model, each displaying unique character marks of use. The humidor barrel contains four metal smoking tools, perfect for pipe maintenance. Visible signs of age include scratches and a noticeable split on the humidor's side, as well as typical wear on the pipes, which speaks to its authentic vintage status. Ideal for a thoughtful gift or a distinguished display, this piece offers a blend of function, history, and visual interest for any tobacco enthusiast or collector
